title: Spec Main Shape Gate red: objectstack `b2805465` adds `computed` to `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']`, and `writeWarningToast`'s wording table plus the batch-6 spec-symbol pin do not compile against objectstack main
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named landing site and a measured reach: the required `Spec Main Shape Gate` fails, so no objectui pull request or merge group can land until it is repaired.
Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` seat 1 claims it at once as a stop-the-bleed under the standing ruling (objectui#10916, `5866275396`): 「A red `Spec Main Shape Gate` on objectui `main` or in its merge queue is lane p0: any `domain:ui` seat claims the repair at once as a stop-the-bleed, ⛔ without waiting for triage's grade.」 Triage grades it afterwards.
Dedup: objectui issues created since 2026-09-30T10:30Z read (13, none about this gate or `computed`); objectui#11024 (the last gate repair, the sparse cone) is closed and a different cause.

## The reading

Job `109859478523` (workflow run `36706993603`) on PR objectui#11205's head `0fb29c5fa`, compiled against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main` `93e9e4263c38` (2026-09-30T10:48Z): 4 diagnostics in 2 objectui files, neither of which that PR touches.

| objectui file | line | code | message |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts` | 119 | TS2741 | Property 'computed' is missing in type … but required in type `Record<"readonly" \| "computed" \| "readonly_when" \| "primary_key", StrippedLine>` (reported three times: app-shell type-check, app-shell build, console type-check) |
| `packages/data-objectstack/src/spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts` | 242 | TS2344 | Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true' (the pin `Equal<DroppedFieldsEvent['reason'], 'readonly' \| 'readonly_when' \| 'primary_key'>`) |

The shape moved in objectstack `b2805465` (2026-09-30T10:22Z), `fix(objectql)!: a caller-supplied formula value is stripped on every write path and reported as computed …`, which adds `computed` to the strip-reason union. The earlier gate runs are green (merge groups at 10:36Z and 10:40Z compiled against an older objectstack `main`), so every run from now on, merge groups included, compiles against the new union and fails the same way. The merge group for PR objectui#11202 (started 11:09Z) was `in_progress` at this reading.

## What the repair is

Both sites were written to fail exactly here: `STRIPPED_LINE`'s docblock says 「the next reason added upstream fails `type-check` HERE, unworded」. So the repair is the one that docblock prescribes, made to compile against BOTH the pinned published spec (17.5.0, no `computed`) and objectstack `main` (with it), the dual-compile shape the gate needs (the `satisfies` precedent documented in `packages/core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts`, objectui#9880):
- a `computed` wording in `STRIPPED_LINE`, through the i18n packs (a new `detail.writeStripped…` key in every locale), saying the value is computed by the server and was not taken, ⛔ not "read-only";
- the batch-6 pin updated so it still asserts the union exactly on each side of the bump, rather than loosened to "includes".
